newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: QNI shrugs off nickel ore supply woes.
newsitem.headline: QNI shrugs off nickel ore supply woes.

text.p: Australian nickel producer QNI Ltd said on Friday it was adequately stocked to weather delays in ore deliveries caused by labor disruptions in New Caledonia.
"We've got a fair amount of ore in our stockpiles so we're not too worried," John Reid, a director of QNI, told Reuters.

Exports of refined nickel and nickel ore from New Caledonia were halted indefinitely earlier on Friday due to an industrial action, nickel producer Ste Metallurgique Le Nickel (SLN) said earlier on Friday.

Union leaders have called a halt to the exports as part of a campaign to press the French government to make a decision on construction of a proposed new nickel smelter in the northern end of the French territory.
SLN, owned by France's Eramet, ships nickel to customers mainly in Asia, Europe and North America, largely stainless steel mills, Mouradian said.

Although SLN does not export nickel in intermediate ore concentrate form for smelting elsewhere, exports of concentrates from mines operating in New Caledonia also had been halted, an SLN official said.
